The regions in Tamil Nadu are categorized into seven agro-climatic zones as follows:

1. Cauvery Delta Zone (Light Green)
2. High Altitude and Hilly Zone (Yellow)
3. High Rainfall Zone (Light Blue)
4. North Eastern Zone (Pink)
5. North Western Zone (Purple)
6. Southern Zone (Orange)
7. Western Zone (Blue) [agri_schemes_2026_27.pdf, p. 19].
